Chinese 刑部員外郎 is a yuanwailang (Vice Director) post in the Ministry of Justice; vice minister would be 侍郎. The replacement correctly restores that rank while leaving the rest of the sentence unchanged.
Wang Sui and Li Chong, famed extortionists, were sent to rich Xuan-She and Zhexi to raise revenue.
Wang Sui and Li Xiao, famed extortionists, were sent to rich Xuan-She and Zhexi to raise revenue.
The personal name 李翛 is Li Xiao (翛 = xiāo), not Chong; the idiomatic 'Li Chong' misreads the character, and 'Li Xiao' restores the correct romanization.

Zhaozong was at Fengxiang, besieged by Liang troops; in the city people ate one another, fathers eating their sons, while the Son of Heaven ate gruel; the six palaces and the imperial clan mostly starved to death.
Chinese states 城中人相食，父食其子 and 六宮及宗室多餓死 as distinct facts beside the emperor eating gruel; the prior idiomatic collapsed these, and the proposed text restores them accurately.
